evidence: The morphology and crystal structure of the TiO2 coatings were studied using scanning electron microscope and X-ray diffraction techniques. After the coating procedure, selected specimens were studied using Digital Instruments NanoScope atomic force microscope. The crystal structure of the coatings was studied with a grazing incidence X-ray diffraction using a Bruker D8 Advance diffractometer. The photoinduced hydrophilicity was studied by means of contact angle measurements of water under ultraviolet irradiation. Electrochemical potential measurements are the most convenient way to measure photoactivity because they reveal immediately the changes of TiO2-coated specimens caused by UV irradiation. The change in the concentration of MB was determined from the relative height change of the absorption peak at 665 nm wavelength in the absorption spectrum.
